arguments_redacted.content: The text-cleanup bug in the src/text.py file is due to the function clean_name(name) not handling the case where the input string is empty or does not have any trailing characters. The expected behavior is to remove any trailing characters, including none. To fix this bug, the function should be modified to remove any trailing characters, including none, like so: def clean_name(name): return name.rstrip().lstrip().
